newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Telstra wins A$50 mln govt contract.
newsitem.headline: Telstra wins A$50 mln govt contract.

text.p: State-owned Telstra Corp Ltd said on Tuesday it has won a three-year A$50 million contract to provide telephone services to the Australian government's social security department.

Sue Vardon, chief executive officer of the Commonwealth Services Delivery Agency, which will take over the delivery of Department of Social Security (DSS) services later this year, said the contract was awarded after a open tendering process.
David Nash, Telstra's general manager of government contracts, said by outsourcing its telephony network to Telstra, DSS would have a state-of-the-art telephone system at a contained and stable cost.
Telstra is wholly owned by the Australia government, which plans to sell a third of its stake in the telecommunictions carrier later this year. -- Sydney newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
